Frequently Asked Questions

How often do Spatial Rifts open in Aion 2?⌄

Spatial Rifts open every 3 hours on the game server (UTC) — at 02:00, 05:00, 08:00, 11:00, 14:00, 17:00, 20:00 and 23:00 server time, 8 openings per day. The countdown at the top converts the next opening to your local timezone.

When is the next Abyss event?⌄

The Abyss event runs on Wednesday and Saturday at 22:00 server time (UTC). The live timer above shows the time in your own zone.

Which world bosses are there and when do they spawn?⌄

Reshanta hosts field bosses such as Watcher Kaira, Executor Argo/Kaira/Tamasa, Enraged Guardian Lord Nahma, Executioner Dramos, Ravager Marakha and Turncoat Ducal. Each shows its next spawn and a link to its exact location on the interactive map.

What timezone does Aion 2 use?⌄

The Aion 2 game server runs on UTC (UTC). Every event time on this page is automatically converted to your device’s local timezone, so you never have to do the math.
